pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-lobed polygons with jagged edges and soft pixel gradients. Dark contiguous regions show significant spatial variation, transitioning from large, consolidated shapes on the mid-flank to smaller, fragmented clusters towards the hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Wide, non-linear negative-space pathways with frequent multi-node junctions. Continuity is maintained throughout the visible torso, with the pixel thickness of the pathways increasing significantly in the posterior region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the superior neck margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, high-reflectance white punctate mark is visible on the posterior flank near the base of the tail.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced skeletal protrusions at the shoulder and pelvic regions create deep, high-contrast shadows within the dorsal-lateral transition zone.
